E · Oral production

The tutor evaluates with the address book 6.3. Indicators for this module: Accuracy is the agreement of colors and adjectives, unchangeable comparison with ⁧مِنْ⁩ , numbers from 3 a 10 with the right polarity, singular accusative after 11– 99; Fluidity • descriptions of at least four sentences, comparisons without long breaks; Pronunciation ⁧ث⁩ in ⁧ثَلَاثَة⁩ and ⁧ثَمَانِيَة⁩ , double consonants in ⁧أَقَلّ⁩ and ⁧أَهَمّ⁩ , unit order + ten in numbers.
